art_direction: A dense, low residential carpet in muted warm gray-beige/taupe with short tightly packed fibers, restrained darker and lighter flecks, matte response, and no broad motifs. The image target is a seamless material swatch; the full room footprint, height, collision, and navigation remain supplied by RoomDefinition.
intended_function: Provide the photo-specific carpet material for the full floor in room_photo_luna while keeping RoomDefinition authoritative for its 156 by 144 inch footprint and floor height.

citizen_scale.ratio_or_view: The production room uses the exact 0.5-inch citizen height; this material does not redefine scale.

construction_materials.construction: continuous surface; small short-pile fibers; no inferred fiber composition

source_photo_constraints: Sample (1) shows warm gray-beige carpet across the visible floor, with shadowed areas beneath the hammock and desk. The short carpet texture and overall color family are evidenced; fiber composition, exact pile height, and hidden floor areas are not. The image does not show a carpet seam, rug border, board, stripe, or large repeat motif. Match the source under RoomScale lighting rather than infer a fabric brand or fiber type.
silhouette_requirements: continuous carpet surface across the exact RoomDefinition floor
no visible tile seam, rug boundary, board, stripe, or broad motif
fiber variation is readable only at close view and remains quiet at room scale
separate_room_assets: RoomDefinition floor mesh, collision, navigation, furniture, and floor height
prohibited_failure_modes: do not alter floor dimensions, height, center, collision, navigation, or object placement
do not add rugs, border strips, or carpet joints not shown in the photograph
do not stretch fibers into large loops or use a broad, high-contrast repeating pattern
do not apply this photo-specific carpet to unrelated rooms
gameplay_distance_readability: Keep the floor quiet at the 64, 160, and 330-inch views; resolve short-pile texture in the 12-inch view without visible repetition.
roomdefinition_authority: RoomDefinition rooms/room_photo_luna.json remains authoritative for the 156 x 144-inch floor, height, collision, navigation, and object placements.
